sentences.text:
Heard on I.A.No.4723/2026, an application for temporary suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of present appellant on account of death of appellant's father who expired on 23.2.2026.
Vide the impugned judgment, the present appellant has been convicted for commission of offence under Section 376(a)(b)/ 511 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years and fine of Rs.3000/- with default stipulation.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the present appellant that the father of the appellant expired on 23.02.2026 and the appellant has to attend customary rites.
In this circumstance, the remaining jail sentence of present appellant may be suspended and he may be released on bail for a period of 30 days.
The learned counsel for the State has submitted that the fact regarding death of appellant's father has been verified and is found to be correct.

As the appellant's father has expired on 23.2.2026 and his last rituals are to be performed by the appellant, it appears just and proper to allow the 2 CRA-3129-2022 application for grant of temporary bail to present appellant.

It is directed that upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the present appellant be released on temporary bail till 12.03.2026 from the date of his release.
The appellant shall surrender before the trial Court on 12.03.2026 for undergoing the remaining part of the jail sentence.
Learned trial Court is directed to intimate the Registry of this Court about surrender of the present appellant.
